timeline.query: why should i study at eth?

timeline.draft_answer: Based on the chunks, reasons to study at ETH include: ETH graduates are in high demand, challenging the stereotype that they need extensive on-the-job adjustment before becoming specialists. ETH covers a broad range of subjects and provides a solid theoretical foundation — it is described as the only institution in Switzerland (together with another, not named in the excerpt) to do so at this level. It offers popular and diverse programmes, including mechanical engineering, computer science, architecture, physics, mathematics, health sciences and technology, and environmental sciences. ETH also has an international network. Beyond degree programmes, it offers vocational training in 15 different trades, with dedicated workshops and training labs. Students are supported through advice centres for virtually any situation that may arise during their studies, and challenges are framed as opportunities for personal development. The evidence does not cover other common factors such as rankings, faculty, campus life, tuition, or career outcomes in detail.
